notes: Imports openevolve.evaluation_result; suite/_lib/openevolve is a verbatim shim of that module.
protocol_description: Verbatim copy of the pinned SCiEL example `examples/function_minimization` (commit da80706f98f9); the evaluator, seed program and configuration are the upstream files. README.upstream.md is the upstream README when one exists.
name: SCiEL: Budgeted two-dimensional function minimization
description: Implement run_search() for the supplied multimodal function. Ten trials score candidate objective values, distance to the stored approximate optimum and reliability.

sources.locator: evaluate and helper validators at immutable commit

limitations: Source-inspected SCiEL example; not a reproduced paper result.
The original evaluator and baseline are fetched at the immutable source commit; no upstream implementation is silently repaired.
A three-value run_search return is trusted for objective value; only two-value returns are recomputed. The 50-call budget lives in the editable seed, not in an independent evaluator.
The ThreadPoolExecutor timeout may wait during executor shutdown; use the outer process timeout.
The upstream evaluator provides no independently trusted validity boolean; a finite returned score remains unverified.

papers.title: SCiEL — Scientific Closed-loop Evolutionary Learning: benchmark examples

Using a task to evaluate an agent, framework, or general-purpose model, or citing only a benchmark, dataset, or tool, does not establish scientific importance.
